title: EC2 Instance Storage
summary: The three places EC2 keeps data: AZ-bound EBS volumes (gp3, gp2, io2 Block Express, io1, st1, sc1, Multi-Attach, delete on termination), snapshots with Archive, Recycle Bin and Fast Snapshot Restore, EBS encryption, custom AMIs, ephemeral instance store, and Amazon EFS shared NFS storage with its throughput modes, storage classes and lifecycle policies.
